name: pi-app
title: Pi agent app
description: AgentWorkspace: a whole agent page in one component. Left: the sessions pane (search, New, rename, archive, delete; collapsible, a drawer on a narrow screen). Center: PiChat. Right: the artifact viewers (artifact panel with versions, file viewer, auto-open of new artifacts) in the ArtifactWorkspace panel, a full-screen sheet on a phone. Props are data and callbacks; hooks for the conversations handler (useConversations), the chat transport (useRemoteChat) and saved resources (useSaved).
